# IBM Plex

Unmodified complete WOFF2 fonts from IBM's npm packages:

- `@ibm/plex-sans` 1.1.0: Regular, Medium, SemiBold.
- `@ibm/plex-mono` 2.5.0: Regular, SemiBold, Bold, Italic.

Source: https://github.com/IBM/plex

Package archives:

- https://registry.npmjs.org/@ibm/plex-sans/-/plex-sans-1.1.0.tgz
- https://registry.npmjs.org/@ibm/plex-mono/-/plex-mono-2.5.0.tgz

Files come from `package/fonts/complete/woff2/`. The shared SIL Open Font
License is included in `LICENSE.txt`. Assets are embedded in the Go binary
and served locally under `/static/vendor/plex/`.
